milestone_full: Layer S - Shui Chuen O - is OPEN. All 180 Hong Kong chapters ship in three arms (Traditional HK / opencc Simplified fold / full English prose). Layer R closed with the brass tags claimed; Layer S follows Ah Man at the first bus in Sha Tin, the nameless ticket that carried only a time, and the kept ticket he waits with the next morning. Deep LLM lanes (world guide, story recap, Wayfinder, cross-chapter corpus RAG, real Wikipedia facts) run with a bounded process-local replay cache. Admin analytics derives next-step measures from real numbers and renders the hourly histogram; deterministic labelled ghost events feed the offline view. IMPORTANT: the gpt-6.2-sol API has been closed by directive for cost control; all later chapters are written in controlled vocabulary by the code lane, and no further live model calls are assumed. Full AI suite 38,065 green; web 975 green; verify_all NO OFFENDER.
headline: Layer S open · 180 chapters in three arms · no further live model calls · bounded replay cache · real web facts · admin measures from numbers · every gate green.
features: D1557: chapter 180 - waiting once more with the kept ticket. Arc 180 chapters, three arms; WORLD_ROADMAP drift repaired (it still said 175 / Layer R); Layer R closed 167-177, Layer S opens at 178.

API closure: the gpt-6.2-sol key is closed by directive for cost control. No further live beats; chapters are written by the code lane in controlled vocabulary. Historical live measurements remain facts, not a promise.
D1513: deterministic labelled ghost events derived from the /insights reader simulator now feed the offline admin analytics read (password 123); no more fake zeros on an unreachable read.
D1512: admin "next measures" are derived from real numbers (OLS slope, peak hour, funnel counts, session density) and the server's hourly histogram is finally rendered.
D1499: provider cache flicker measured (95.3% / 0% on identical calls) and removed with a bounded in-process replay arm: 1 provider call + 5 zero-token replays.
D1497: cross-chapter RAG over real chapter bodies (7,937-token prompt measured) with fenced citations; zero-token Wikipedia facts door also live.
privacy_note: All consumer fixtures are synthetic (demo flags); no real merchant, stall or operator is represented. /insights replay is deterministic synthetic inference, not stored user data. All REAL-HK figures are public sources with URLs inline on the handbook page.
milestone_full_zh: Layer S（水泉澳邨）已開啟。全部 180 章香港系列以三語臂呈現（繁體香港／opencc 簡體／完整英文）。Layer R 以銅牌被認走收官；Layer S 跟著阿文在沙田等頭班車、那張只有時間的無名票，以及隔天他帶著留下來的票再等一次。深度 LLM 通道（世界向導、故事回顧、Wayfinder、全語料問答、真實維基資料）配合有界進程內重播快取運行。管理員分析從真實數字推導下一步措施並顯示每小時分佈；確定性且標明來源的模擬事件供離線檢視。**重要：gpt-6.2-sol API 已因成本控制關閉；後續章節由程式在受控詞彙內撰寫，不再假設有 live 模型呼叫。** 全套 AI 38,065 綠、web 975 綠、verify_all 全綠。
headline_zh: Layer S 開啟 · 180 章三語臂 · 不再呼叫 live 模型 · 有界重播快取 · 真實聯網資料 · 管理員措施由數字推導 · 所有閘門全綠。
features_zh: D1557：第 180 章——帶著留下來的票再等一次。全系列 180 章三語臂；修好 WORLD_ROADMAP 漂移（原仍寫 175／Layer R）；Layer R 於 167–177 收官，Layer S 從 178 開啟。
API 關閉：gpt-6.2-sol key 因成本控制由指令關閉。不再有 live 選節拍；章節由程式在受控詞彙內撰寫。先前的 live 測量仍是事實，不是承諾。
D1513：由 /insights 讀者模擬器衍生的確定性、標明來源的模擬事件，現在供離線管理員分析頁使用（密碼 123）；不再把讀取失敗當成假零。
D1512：管理員「下一步措施」從真實數字推導（最小平方法斜率、尖峰小時、漏斗計數、工作階段密度），並終於渲染伺服器每小時直方圖。
D1499：實測並修掉快取抖動（相同呼叫 95.3%／0%）——有界進程內重播：1 次供應商呼叫＋5 次零 token 重播。
D1497：對真實章節內文做跨章節 RAG（實測 7,937-token prompt），附圍欄引文；另有零 token 維基百科資料門。
